summary: Marriage of 40 days via Facebook; petitioner (Canadian resident) seeks transfer of divorce case from Mangaluru to Mumbai; respondent (doctor) opposes on grounds of irretrievable breakdown; mediation failed after 50-hour sessions; petitioner previously worked in Canada; no child; petitioner's language barrier (Kannada) and job security claimed; Court rejects transfer citing petitioner's international mobility, no hardship disproportionate to respondent; restitution petition filed by petitioner countered divorce proceedings; Article 142 divorce power not exercised without mutual consent.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 142 of the Constitution of India
R. Srinivas Kumar v. R. Shametha (2019) 9 SCC 409
Munish Kakkar v. Nidhi Kakkar (2020) 14 SCC 657
Anindita Das v. Srijit Das (2006) 9 SCC 197
final_judgment: Petition for transfer of case from Mangaluru to Mumbai dismissed; parties to continue proceedings at Mangaluru; liberty to seek travel expense reimbursement granted.
